testimonials.name: Austin Rideshare Analyst
testimonials.text: Austin's premium rideshare segment has grown 40% year-over-year. The market consistently lacks enough Black-tier vehicles to meet demand — especially during events like SXSW, ACL, and F1. A well-branded luxury SUV fleet with instant visual recognition is exactly what this market needs.

about.mission: To build Austin's most recognizable luxury SUV fleet, deploy it in the highest-earning rideshare tiers, and create a scalable model for premium fleet ownership that benefits investors, drivers, and the community.
about.story: Ezra Mobility Group LLC was founded in Austin, Texas — one of the fastest-growing cities in the US and a top-tier rideshare market. We saw a gap: there aren't enough premium Black-tier SUVs to meet demand, especially during major events. Our solution: a fleet of identical black-on-black luxury SUVs with custom gloss-pink bumper guards that make every pickup instantly recognizable. We're in our launch phase and actively seeking investment partners and vehicle owner-operators to bring this vision to the road.

values.title: Market Fit First
values.description: Austin's premium rideshare demand far exceeds supply. Our fleet targets the highest-revenue tiers with zero competition on branding.

values.title: Unmistakable Identity

values.title: Scalable Partnership Model
values.description: We structure investments and partnerships so everyone wins: investors, owner-operators, and drivers. No one carries the full burden alone.
